name: Price Action
description: Trade using pure price movement without relying on indicators. Focus on candlestick patterns, market structure, and key support and resistance levels.

name: Breakout Trading
description: Enter trades when price breaks above resistance or below support with strong momentum.

name: Scalping
description: Take many small trades throughout the day to capture quick market movements.

name: Swing Trading
description: Hold positions for several days to benefit from medium-term price swings.

name: Position Trading
description: Trade long-term trends based on technical and fundamental analysis.

name: Trend Following
description: Identify the market trend and trade only in its direction.

name: Range Trading
description: Buy near support and sell near resistance while the market moves sideways.

name: Supply and Demand
description: Use institutional buying and selling zones to identify high-probability trade setups.

name: Support and Resistance
description: Trade around key price levels where buying and selling pressure repeatedly appears.

name: Moving Average Crossover
description: Generate buy and sell signals when moving averages cross.

name: Fibonacci Retracement
description: Use Fibonacci levels to find pullback entries in trending markets.

name: News Trading
description: Trade market volatility during major economic announcements.

name: ICT Concepts
description: Apply liquidity concepts, fair value gaps, and market structure shifts to trading.

name: Smart Money Concepts
description: Trade using order blocks, liquidity sweeps, and institutional order flow.

name: Momentum Trading
description: Follow strong market momentum and enter trades with the prevailing move.
